address.full_key_check: Occupied leaves retain the exact EntityKey. Same address with different full key is AddressCollision, never absence, overwrite or business IdReuse.
address.hash: SHA256 of the complete canonical EntityKey record bytes

branch.summary_authentication: Every summary is bound to the subtree root whose node bytes define it. A scalar beside an unrelated digest is insufficient.

empty_roots.leaf: SHA256 of the canonical count=0 SparseLeaf record for the selected kind
empty_roots.recurrence: At depth d=255..0, hash the canonical SparseBranch with both child roots equal to the already defined empty root at d+1, all counts0 and positive=true/complete_coverage=true.
empty_roots.storage: Empty subtree objects may be shared/omitted only because their exact roots are derived from these definitions.

leaf.empty_fields: Any count=0 encoding with a noncanonical placeholder key/live value or positive=false is rejected. Empty placeholders do not introduce a business entity.
leaf.empty_used_value: No EntityValue field, as required by kind=2.
leaf.leaf_coverage: Complete by definition only after the actual leaf/count/value check; no extra encoded leaf field.

open_bridges: Actual native sparse-node and field-matrix encoding
Canonical empty-byte/root theorems and final full release recipe
scope: Refines previously unimplemented SparseLeaf/SparseBranch semantics. Existing tags, field order, bounds, primitive artifacts and base profile bytes are unchanged. A full release must bind this addendum digest in its semantic profile; an older profile alone is insufficient.

semantic_limits.capacity_conflict: The previously recorded three create-at-full-used-capacity cells remain resource-limited; this addendum does not increase that cap.
semantic_limits.identity_utf8: Exact bytes, without Unicode normalization invented by033. Empty id remains a valid potential occupied key; count0/1 distinguishes it from the placeholder.
